goal: Run node, wallet, and GUI components in isolated processes instead of a monolithic address space
Prevent security bugs or crashes in the GUI or wallet from compromising node validation
agreement: Broad concept support across contributors and maintainers
Supports process separation direction but prefer avoiding Cap'n Proto (gmaxwell, dcousens)
Concept ACK for isolated processes and accepts internal Cap'n Proto IPC (laanwj)
Concept ACK, liking the ability to start GUI on demand without waiting to sync (Sjors)
Verified by testing builds and regtest (jimhashhq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it delivers the foundational architecture to isolate node, wallet, and GUI processes
Enforces security privilege boundaries across major subsystems
